def equation(t, x, v, params):

    S=np.sin(w*t)
    p=params
    return (p[1] + p[2]*v + p[3]*np.log(v) + p[4]*np.sqrt(v) + p[5]*np.exp(-v)
            + p[6]*S*np.sqrt(v) + p[7]*t*t + p[8]*v**1.5 + p[9]*v*v)
